plans.idea: Classic left-aligned editorial column: brand mark at the top, a large hero product, then headline, subcopy and stock line as one block, with the Taste the Glow pill directly under its copy and legal on the bottom edge, so it reads brand → product → message → action.

Message-led like the original: logo, then a big headline block and the CTA pill in the upper half, with the product box anchoring the lower half and legal at the foot, so headline and action stay dominant and the hero gives the page its visual weight.

Product-first poster: the hero spans the full width at the top, the headline copy sits in the middle, and a bottom sign-off row pairs the CTA pill on the left with the Solstice logo on the right, above a legal line.
